name: hud_duel_bar
description: The duel bar (design 1.4 and 5.7, contract-m7.md §3) on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker: in a duel a plate hangs under the resource strip on the right, where a race's rival line hangs, with a row for each side, mine first: the lives each Holdfast keeps, the breach each has dealt, the stipend each earns a wave, and each side's Seawall charges as gems, mine beside the F key. It follows the simulation's records as they move: lives lost earn charges (one each four lives lost, set through the logged lives setter), the stipend grows when a pack is uncorked (mine by Space, the caretaker's by itself), and a creep of my pack that reaches the rival's Holdfast is breach dealt, told with the gold it pays. The wave list hangs under it while it shows. Outside a duel it hides, and a race keeps its rival line.

steps.msg: the duel bar shows; no race line

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').lines() == ['You · 20 lives · 0 breach · +0 a wave · Seawall 0 (F)', 'Rival · 20 lives · 0 breach · +0 a wave · Seawall 0']
steps.msg: both sides at the start: 20 lives, nothing dealt, no stipend, no charge

steps.assert: bar.end.x <= 1280 - 12 and bar.end.x >= 1280 - 16 and bar.position.y >= strip.end.y and bar.position.y <= strip.end.y + 4 and bar.end.y < 200 and bar.position.x > 640
steps.msg: hung under the strip's right end, in the right half

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').find_child('KeyTab', true, false).visible and node('DuelBar').find_child('KeyTab', true, false).get_node('Hotkey').text == 'F'
node('DuelBar').lines() == ['You · 12 lives · 0 breach · +0 a wave · Seawall 2 (F)', 'Rival · 17 lives · 0 breach · +0 a wave · Seawall 0']
steps.msg: it follows the records: eight lives lost earn two charges, three lost earn none

steps.assert: node('Lives0').text == '12' and node('Lives1').text == '17' and Game.sim.seawall_charges(1) == 2 and Game.sim.seawall_charges(2) == 0
steps.msg: the numbers as the cells show them, the charges the simulation's
the caretaker rival's gold, so it corks in window 2: tier I costs 45 since the sends' pass, more than its fifth of what it holds there

steps.assert: Game.sim.stipend(1) == 4 and Game.sim.stipend(2) == 4 and node('Stipend0').text == '+4' and node('Stipend1').text == '+4'
steps.msg: my pack uncorked by Space and the caretaker's by itself: each stipend grows by tier I's 4
my pack's creeps on the rival's road walk to its Holdfast

steps.assert: Game.sim.breach_dealt(0) == rival_lives - Game.sim.teams[1].lives and Game.sim.breach_dealt(0) >= 2 and node('Breach0').text == str(Game.sim.breach_dealt(0)) and node('Breach1').text == '0'
steps.msg: a breach: the lives my creeps took are breach dealt, on my row
told with the gold it pays me

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').lines()[0] == 'You · %d lives · %d breach · +4 a wave · Seawall %d (F)' % [Game.lives, Game.sim.breach_dealt(0), Game.sim.seawall_charges(1)]
steps.msg: my row as the records stand
the wave list hangs under the bar
a race: the rival line, no duel bar
